reason: Each FR-04 requirement is pinned by real assertions: hierarchy (SPEC L111) by status checks at test_fr04.py L250/L259/L270 (write covers read, admin covers read, read does NOT cover admin); 403 + no-existence-leak (SPEC L112) by status, problem+json content-type, type field, and structural-identity body comparison at L324/L331/L342/L351/L380/L389; single shared dependency (SPEC L113) by import-count assertion at L469 and callable check at L487.

gaps.message: Self-echo assertion `assert lower_scope == "read" and higher_scope == "admin"` merely re-checks the test's own local variable; the real hierarchy proof comes from the downstream status-code assertions at L250/L259/L270. Coexists harmlessly with the real checks.

Self-echo assertion `assert expected_body_contains_task_id == "false"` only re-checks a test-local literal; the real no-existence-leak proof is `real_task_id not in response_real.text` at L351 and the structural-identity comparison of real-vs-fake response bodies at L380/L385/L386/L389. Coexists harmlessly with the real checks.
